sloka: इत्येवं मैथिलीं दृष्ट्वा विलपन्तीं तपस्विनीम्।रोहिणीमिव चन्द्रेण विना ग्रहवशं गताम् ।। ६.९३.६० ।।
transliteration: ityevaṁ maithilīṁ dṛṣṭvā vilapantīṁ tapasvinīm।rohiṇīmiva candreṇa vinā grahavaśaṁ gatām ।। 6.93.60 ।।

translations.english: 'Because of the sinful resolve of hunch back Mandara, this grief has come to Kausalya surely. Let her be burnt'.
